# ZothOS Linux v3.2 (zoth-pill) — Complete Technical Grounding Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Canonical URL: https://zothos.nullai.tech/llms-full.txt
> Companion Studio: https://zoth.nullai.tech
> Maintainer: Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30) • NullAI Platform (https://nullai.tech)
> Version: 3.2.0-amd64 (Debian 13 Trixie • Linux 6.12 Hybrid UEFI • KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland)

================================================================================
SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY
================================================================================
ZothOS Linux v3.2 (`zoth-pill`) is a sovereign operating system engineered from the ground up for autonomous AI agent orchestration, offensive cybersecurity operations, and cryptographic zero-egress privacy.

1. Base System: Debian 13 (Trixie) with Linux 6.12 LTS/Hybrid UEFI kernel.
2. Surgical Tri-Repository APT Pinning: Debian 13 at pin 900, Kali Rolling and Parrot Security at pin 400. Curated security packages are the 75 entries in `30-opsec` and `40-security`, not the full Kali archive.
3. Desktop Environment: KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland. `zoth-mode` switches gold, ghost, matrix, and incognito (alias win11). `zoth-cockpit` on git main (23 Oct 2026) also cycles cyan. That cockpit change is not in the 13 Oct v3.2.0 ISO.
4. Thermal: `zoth-thermal` can write Intel `no_turbo`. `zoth-heal` repairs APT, display, network/Tor, disk, audio, Python/MCP, and desktop config. Neither script guarantees a temperature or a fan speed.
5. Download: v3.2.0 release assets are five ISO parts, `zothos-join-iso.sh`, `SHA256SUMS`, and `SHA256SUMS.cosign.bundle`. No qcow2 is published. Studio CLI is `npx @nullaitech/zoth studio`, which is not the OS installer.
6. Supply chain: cosign signs `SHA256SUMS` for v3.2.0. Reproducible builds are in progress and are not bit-for-bit (see REPRODUCIBLE_BUILDS.md in the OS repo). The vault daemon is prebuilt; Argon2id parameter numbers are not published in source.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: FOUR REALITY PILL OPERATIONAL MODES (`zoth-mode`)
================================================================================
Operators and MCP agents can switch system posture in under 250ms:
- `zoth-mode gold` (Sovereign Gold Master — Default): 24K Celtic Gold KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland desktop, UFW default-deny inbound, 22 loopback daemons active, Tailscale mesh ready.
- `zoth-mode ghost` (NullAI Ghostmode Stealth — Red Pill): System-wide transparent Tor routing (`9040` transport / `9053` DNS) via nftables, cryptographic MAC address spoofing, ephemeral hostname rotation, and automatic RAM tmpfs scrubbing on poweroff.
- `zoth-mode matrix` (Hermetic Matrix Phosphor — Green Pill): High-contrast emerald phosphor cyber-deck profile tuned for nocturnal red-team reconnaissance, HexStrike AI terminal auditing, and zero eye strain.
- `zoth-mode incognito` (alias `win11`): Covert desktop wallpaper. Cockpit calls this reality CORTEX-PRO.
- Cockpit-only `cyan` reality (KITSUNE-Q9) exists on git main. `zoth-mode` rejects `cyan`.

================================================================================
SECTION 3: 22 RESIDENT LOOPBACK DAEMONS (127.0.0.1 ENCLAVE MESH)
================================================================================
Every ZothOS daemon binds strictly to `127.0.0.1` and never exposes public network sockets:
- `:8094` — `neuro-memory-daemon` (Python / SQLite STDP): Biomorphic Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (`dw = A+ * exp(-dt/tau)`) synaptic vector memory & HNSW index.
- `:8095 / :8096` — `agent-egress-sentinel` (Python / TLS SNI Proxy): Zero-dependency outbound packet inspector and telemetry blocker.
- `:8097` — `agent-mock-twin` (Python / JSON-RPC): Deterministic offline API replay twin for testing subagents without internet access.
- `:8098 / :8099` — `agent-prompt-firewall` (Python / Regex AST): Inline prompt injection defense, jailbreak heuristic scanner, and automatic PII redactor.
- `:8104` — `agent-flight-recorder` (Python / SQLite): Immutable cryptographic black-box event recorder for every agent tool call and shell command.
- `:8105` — `agent-capsule-jail` (Python / Linux Cgroups v2): Kernel-level enclave sandbox enforcing strict RAM, CPU, and filesystem quotas on untrusted agent tasks.
- `:8106` — `agent-policy-auditor` (Python / Ed25519): Cryptographic capability leaser and automated OWASP LLM Top-10 compliance auditor.
- `:8107` — `etsy-pod-forge` (FastMCP / Pillow): Lifestyle mockup compositor and 2026 Etsy ranking algorithm 13-tag SEO optimizer.
- `:8108` — `etsy-connector` (FastMCP / Open API v3): Etsy seller fee/margin calculator, competitor listing auditor, and draft product publisher.
- `:8109` — `mcp-lens` (FastMCP / Inspector): Real-time Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 packet sniffer and latency profiler.
- `:8110 / :8111` — `agent-budget-sentinel` (Python / Reverse Proxy): Real-time financial circuit breaker and token spend limiter across all LLM API providers.
- `:8112` — `agent-gods-eye` (Python / OSINT Radar): Planetary OSINT threat radar, subdomain aggregator, and exposed industrial asset mapper.
- `:8113` — `shopify-connector` (FastMCP / GraphQL): Transpiles Etsy listings into Shopify GraphQL draft products and audits inventory margins.
- `:8114` — `agent-voice-call` (Python / WebRTC P2P): Full-duplex low-latency neural voice calling cockpit with local speech synthesis.
- `:8115` — `printify-connector` (FastMCP / REST v1): Automated Print-on-Demand catalog pricing, 20% margin enforcement, and blueprint router.
- `:8116` — `gelato-connector` (FastMCP / REST v2): Localized print fulfillment routing across 32 countries with tariff & shipping optimization.
- `:8117` — `pod-smart-router` (FastMCP / Arbitrage): Real-time landed-cost and SLA speed arbitration engine between Printify and Gelato.
- `:8118` — `digital-asset-forge` (FastMCP / 300 DPI): Generates 5-ratio 300 DPI printable wall art master packs with 98% digital profit margins.
- `:8119` — `pod-mockup-forge` (FastMCP / Lumen Matrix): Photorealistic apparel and canvas mockup studio with displacement map ink blending.
- `:8120` — `pod-margin-sentinel` (FastMCP / Math Solver): Multi-channel break-even solver and ROAS ad-spend simulator.
- `:9393` — `zoth-civilization` (Node.js / Three.js 3D): 21-Agent autonomous society simulation, 3D Golden Sanctum world, and Adytum Great Work loop.
- `:8787` — `zoth-vault`: Local secrets daemon. README describes Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305 and states the binary is prebuilt, so those details are not auditable here. Do not cite specific Argon2 memory or time settings.
- `:9989` — `zoth-cursor-daemon` (Python / KWin DBus): 60 FPS Wayland/X11 global cursor broadcaster (`127.0.0.1:9989` + `/dev/shm/zoth_cursor_pos`) powering desktop constellation & aura physics.

Desktop launchers on current main also include OpenCode/Codex. Treat them as launchers, not as proof that every binary is baked into the 13 Oct ISO.
